reason: Intermex sells consumer-to-consumer cross-border remittances to immigrants through agents, stores and apps. Evertec is a B2B and B2G transaction-processing and technology provider to financial institutions, merchants, fintechs and governments. Both are payments-related and Latin America-focused, but the products and buyers differ.
reason_if_0: Different customers: Intermex serves retail immigrant senders, while Evertec serves institutions, merchants and governments. The business models also differ. Intermex earns per-transfer fees and FX spread as a licensed money transmitter. Evertec earns processing, software and service fees as a technology vendor.
